fusions.name: Webbed Splash
fusions.desc: Kicks a spray of water ahead with webbed feet, dealing 7 damage to every enemy in a cone 3 tiles ahead, with a 50% chance to leave each [Soaked] for 5 seconds. Holds 3 charges, and a kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Skidding Landing
fusions.desc: Glides in and lands feet-first on a target up to 5 tiles away, skidding into it for 12 damage, up to 1.5 times that from the full distance, and knocking it 3 tiles back.

fusions.name: Water off the Back
fusions.desc: For 6 seconds, each affliction laid on you has a 50% chance to be sent back to its source. You move 15% faster for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Unruffled Balance
fusions.desc: Once every 8 seconds, a failed dodge is rolled a second time, and the second roll stands.
